description: NaScSnO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-57°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.17 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-56°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-56°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.13 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-57°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.12 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Sn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScSn₂ square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Sn atom to form distorted ONa₂Sc₂Sn square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Sc₂Sn trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₂ScSn₂ square pyramids, and edges with four ONa₂Sc₂Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScSn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Sn atom to form distorted ONa₂Sc₂Sn trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sc₂Sn square pyramids, corners with three ONa₂ScSn₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Sc₂Sn square pyramid, and edges with six ONa₂ScSn₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form distorted ONa₂ScSn₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂ScSn₂ square pyramids, corners with seven ONa₂ScSn₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₂ScSn₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Sc₂Sn trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Sn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Sc₂Sn trigonal bipyramids.
